title: The Right to Set Up Practice
subtitle: Dr Ramdan & Dr Kamali Count on You
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! ⚖️

You are faced with a major legal challenge: Dr Ramdan and Dr Kamali, two ambitious dentists, are about to sign the lease for their new dental practice.

But Law 49-16 is a labyrinth: renewal, eviction compensation, assignment, subletting, deadlines, charges, rent revision...

Their professional future rests on YOUR shoulders.

Each question is a strategic decision. Each correct answer brings you closer to a perfectly negotiated lease.

chapters.debutant1:
📘 CHAPTER 1 - The Fundamentals of Law 49-16

Dr Ramdan and Dr Kamali, two ambitious young dentists, have finally found the ideal location for their future dental practice. But before signing the lease, they must understand the basics of Law 49-16, which governs commercial leases.

"Doctor, we are counting on you to guide us through this legal labyrinth," says Dr Ramdan, pen in hand.

Dr Kamali adds: "Every article of this law can make the difference between a successful lease and a legal nightmare."

Your mission: help them master the fundamentals of the commercial lease. From articles 1 to 33, each provision is a piece of the puzzle. Their professional future begins here, with you.
chapters.debutant2:
📗 CHAPTER 2 - Deepening Tenant Rights

The two dentists have signed their lease, but questions are flooding in. Dr Ramdan wonders: "What happens if the landlord wants to increase the rent abusively?"

Dr Kamali worries: "And if we want to assign the lease one day? What are our rights?"

You delve deeper into Law 49-16. Tenant rights are numerous: right to renewal, right to eviction compensation, right to sublet, right to assign the lease...

"Every right is a conquest that must be defended," you remind your two protégés. Their practice is beginning to take shape, but vigilance is required.
chapters.intermediaire1:
📙 CHAPTER 3 - The Pitfalls of the Commercial Lease

Dr Ramdan and Dr Kamali have signed their lease, but the adventure is only beginning... The first months of operation reveal legal gray areas.

"Why are these condominium charges when they are not mentioned in the lease?" wonders Dr Ramdan as he checks his bank statements.

Dr Kamali, meanwhile, has received a letter from the landlord: "He wants to increase the rent by 50% without justification! This is a blow to our cash flow!"

The landlord, an experienced businessman, knows every corner of the law. He has slipped obscure clauses into the lease that no one has really read.

Your expertise is more needed than ever to navigate the troubled waters of the commercial lease. Every hidden clause, every unforeseen charge, every abusive revision is a trap to be avoided.

"We are counting on you, Doctor, to get us out of this labyrinth," pleads Dr Ramdan.

The dentists realize that signing the lease was only the beginning. The real legal battle starts now.
chapters.intermediaire2:
📕 CHAPTER 4 - Negotiation and Conflicts

Tension is rising between our two dentists and their landlord. Between unforeseen charges, disputed works, and rent revision demands, the atmosphere is becoming electric.

"He refuses to cover the roofing works even though the lease provides for it!" exclaims Dr Kamali as he consults the notarial deed.

The landlord, for his part, threatens: "If you don't pay the charges within 15 days, I will request the termination of the lease!"

The exchanges are tense, registered letters are piling up, threats are flying. You must arbitrate and find legal solutions to preserve the fragile balance between the parties.

"Doctor, we need your legal wisdom," says Dr Ramdan, his gaze tired but determined.

The conflict is latent, ready to explode at any moment. A wrong decision could cost the two dentists their practice.
chapters.expert1:
📒 CHAPTER 5 - Litigation Strategy

The landlord has decided to evict our two dentists. Threats are pouring in, summons are piling up.

"He sent us a notice for personal recovery, but I am convinced he simply wants to rent the premises at a higher price," confides Dr Ramdan, holding a summons file.

Dr Kamali, meanwhile, has received a court summons: "We have to appear in 15 days. What do we do?"

It's time to deploy an offensive legal strategy. Every decision is a chess move that can save or condemn their practice.

"We cannot lose this battle," insists Dr Kamali.

You analyze every article, every precedent, every argument. The legal battle promises to be tough, but you are determined to defend the interests of your protégés.
chapters.expert2:
🏆 CHAPTER 6 - Certification and Succession

After years of fierce struggle, Dr Ramdan and Dr Kamali have survived all the trials. The litigation is behind them, the judgments have been handed down in their favor.

"We won, Doctor!" exclaims Dr Kamali, tears in his eyes.

But a new challenge awaits them: passing on their expertise to the new generation of dentists.

"Our practice is thriving, but it's time to think about the future," reflects Dr Ramdan.

You will accompany them in this final dance, that of succession and certification. Their successors must master Law 49-16, understand the issues of the commercial lease, and perpetuate the legacy.

"We owe everything to you, Doctor. You have made us experts in commercial lease law," says Dr Ramdan with emotion.

Their story becomes a legend in the dental world, a model of perseverance and success. And you, their mentor, are the key to this exceptional achievement.
